materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/database rows were sufficient for gate-changing values; supplementary landing bins are HTML/article/support pages and add no structured activity tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked linked APD6/DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows against Table 2, Table 3, Figure 7, article metadata, and database JSONL traceability. Source-supported DBAASP/CAMP Staphylococcus aureus MIC ranges are source_verified; exact hemolysis and external APD6/dbAMP activity/MOA text remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the previous parser failure by extracting 39 source-located rows: XML Table 3 IP MIC values, XML Table 4 comparator MRSA MIC values, and bounded qualitative killing/toxicity/hemolysis rows from figures/prose. No database-only activity row is treated as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated placeholder mechanism text with bounded source-located claims: structure/activity context, phenotypic short-time killing, non-direct membrane-mechanism discussion, and host-toxicity context. No direct mechanism is asserted without a direct assay.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports low/minimal hemolysis at high IP concentration but not the linked database exact 4% value as a text/table value.
APD6/dbAMP rows contain organisms, uM values, or later MOA text absent from the 2016 local primary source; supported Staphylococcus aureus ranges are retained separately.
Short-time killing and host-cell figures support qualitative claims; no exact graph-only percentages were invented.
Local supplementary_original landing-*.bin files were checked with file/rg and are HTML/article or support pages, not parsable spreadsheet/PDF supplements that change gate-bearing values.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local primary text/caption supports low or <5-6% hemolysis at 200 μg/mL, but no exact 4% text/table value was recovered.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: DBAASP exact hemolysis value is preserved as source_conflict; primary toxicity row keeps the supported upper-bound value.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: APD6/dbAMP entry text lists organisms, uM values, and later MOA claims not present in the local 2016 primary source materials.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Unsupported database claims remain source_conflict and are not used as primary activity rows.

adjudication_summary: Source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 for worker-2/4/6: parser-missed MIC tables were recovered, database conflicts were preserved with primary-source locators, mechanism claims were bounded, and no blocking/major issue remains. Final status is accepted_with_cautions, not clean acceptance.
title: Functional structure and antimicrobial activity of persulcatusin, an antimicrobial peptide from the hard tick Ixodes persulcatus.
publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions after bounded source recovery: all gate-changing local activity/database/mechanism values are either source-supported or explicitly preserved as nonblocking source_conflict/unrecoverable gaps.
